cuts.example_text: a navy high-waisted bikini with a supportive halter top
cuts.scene: She steps over a small foamy wave at a sunlit resort beach; a blue beach ball rolls beside the dune fence.
cuts.outfit: The navy bikini has pale-blue piping, fully lined cups and secure halter ties, exposing shoulders, waist and legs.

cuts.scene: At her apartment sewing table after sunset, she sorts a spool of thread into a shallow wooden organizer.
cuts.outfit: A white satin sleeveless button shirt with blue zigzag edging, cropped above the waist with an open-back panel, and matching lounge shorts reveal shoulders, upper back, waist and legs.

cuts.example_text: a masquerade costume with a feathered eye mask, a structured bodice, and a full skirt
cuts.scene: Under a theater dressing-room bulb arch she lifts a feathered eye mask by its handle before joining the masquerade.
cuts.outfit: An ice-blue structured strapless dress has an asymmetric full skirt with a thigh-high opening; the exposed shoulders and leg contrast with white feather trim.

cuts.example_text: Water-Pokémon aquarium keeper testing water beside a feeding bucket and a spacious habitat tank.
cuts.scene: Blue aquarium light falls across a water-testing vial and a small feeding bucket; she compares the vial against a color strip.
cuts.outfit: A sleeveless cream work shirt tied above the waist and orange tailored utility shorts expose shoulders, midriff and legs; she wears rubber-soled deck shoes.

cuts.example_text: a boyshort swimsuit set with a fitted top and short square-cut bottoms
cuts.scene: On a lakeside resort jetty she sits on a low mooring block and squeezes water from a small towel after swimming.
cuts.outfit: A teal fitted swim top and matching square-cut boyshort bottoms have orange edge bindings, exposing shoulders, waist and legs.

cuts.scene: Beside the upper terrace rail of an evening riverboat she holds a folded invitation while harbor lights blur across the water.
cuts.outfit: A copper satin halter dress has an open back and a high side slit revealing the back, shoulders and one leg.
